Emma (Marketing): Quick thought — lets run a 45min webinar focused on practical runbooks for scaling inference: short case studies + a live demo that highlights routing/fallbacks. Prefer Wed Apr 13 or Thu Apr 14. Who can present demos and own run-of-show?
Liam (DemandGen): +1 to Wed Apr 13 if that works for everyone. Metrics angle will help conversions.
Sofie (Product Marketing): I can draft a 2-sentence abstract. Idea: "Practical inference playbooks: how teams cut token costs, keep latency predictable, and architect fallbacks for reliability. Includes real customer tradeoffs and a live demo." Thoughts?
Sanjay (Evangelism): I can do the live demo if we keep it scoped. Plan: show a request routing failure and automatic fallback to a lower-cost variant so latency/SLOs stay intact. Need a deterministic demo dataset.
Noah (Growth): Janes, could we tie a quick benchmark snapshot to the registration page? e.g., "typical 99th percentile latency: 120ms with batching" — helps ad copy.
Emma (Marketing): Good call. We need one short, non-technical headline for signup + a longer abstract. Sofie, please iterate. Liam can you own the landing copy and CTA?
Liam (DemandGen): Yep. Ill build the page and set up the registration funnel. Need recommended KPIs: CPL target and demo watch %?
Noah (Growth): CPL target = $60 initial. Watch-to-QA conversion goal 25%.
Sofie (Product Marketing): Draft abstract options:
1) Short: "Inference Playbooks: Cost, Latency, and Reliable Routing"
2) Long: "Join us for a hands-on session where we walk through operational patterns for running LLM inference at scale. Learn how teams reduce per-token cost, avoid latency spikes, and design graceful fallbacks — plus a live demo."
Which is better?
Sanjay (Evangelism): I prefer the long one for the event page and the short one for the ad creative.
Emma (Marketing): Nice. Next: run-of-show. I sketched a 45min timeline — thoughts / owners?
Emma (Marketing): ```
00:00-03:00 — Welcome + goals (Emma)
03:00-12:00 — Customer case study (Sofie)
12:00-25:00 — Demo: routing + fallback (Sanjay)
25:00-33:00 — Benchmarks & tradeoffs (Liam + Noah)
33:00-40:00 — Product Q&A (panel)
40:00-45:00 — CTA & close (Emma)
```
Liam (DemandGen): Looks good. Can we add a 2-min buffer after the demo in case of hiccups? Suggest shift panel to 35:00-42:00, close 42:00-45:00.
Sofie (Product Marketing): Also propose a short pre-demo checklist for the rehearsal: network proxies set, demo dataset seeded, fallback model variant staged.
Sanjay (Evangelism): Agreed. Ill own checklist and dry-run demo script. Need dry-run slot: Tue Apr 5 or Wed Apr 6?
Emma (Marketing): Dry run Wed Apr 6 10am PT works for most. Marking it.
deploy-bot: CI deploy for demo infra succeeded — https://ci.example.com/builds/12345 :white_check_mark:
Sanjay (Evangelism): Nice. Ill validate demo infra on Mon Apr 4 and call out any infra flags.
Noah (Growth): For registration tracking: please add utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=inference_playbooks. Liam, ping me once the page is live and Ill wire ads.
Liam (DemandGen): Will do. Also proposing a short pre-event email to attendees 24h and 1h before live. Template needed.
Sofie (Product Marketing): Slide owners: Ill do the case study slides (6-7 slides). Sanjay sends demo screenshots + script. Liam + Noah add one slide each for benchmark takeaways. Emma will compile final deck.
Emma (Marketing): Slide deadline: Tue Apr 12 EOD so we have time to rehearse.
Sanjay (Evangelism): Noted. Also planning a fallback content-only plan in case demo flaps: we run a recorded walkthrough + screenshots and a short live Q&A.
Emma (Marketing): Good failover. Add to run-of-show notes and rehearse the switch during dry run.
Noah (Growth): Quick ask: can we get a one-line sponsor blurb for partners? Need it for the landing page.
Liam (DemandGen): Ill draft a neutral sponsor line and share in the doc.
Emma (Marketing): Summary of owners: Landing & registration — Liam. Abstract & case study — Sofie. Demo & failover plan — Sanjay. Benchmarks & growth metrics — Noah. Deck & run-of-show — Emma. Dry run Wed Apr 6 10am PT. Slides due Tue Apr 12 EOD.
Sofie (Product Marketing): Sounds good. Ill post the abstract options in the Google doc for quick review.
Liam (DemandGen): +1. Ill start the landing and link the draft here.
Emma (Marketing): Thanks team — huge progress. If anyone hits a blocker, ping this thread or drop into #marketing ops. :rocket:
